text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen. What Satono Diamond is 
about to challenge is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen, whom she had admired even 
before enrolling in Tracen Academy, and 
her rival, Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Kitasan Black—the rival she had always 
wanted to catch up to and defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She would defeat them and make her dream 
come true. Satono Diamond made a solemn 
vow to seize victory!
